schema-delta.notes: Generalize single-string `install-target` → host-keyed `install` descriptor (HYBRID: type + chosen profiles/hosts + overrides). Add `config`, `serves`, `profiles`, `source` (provenance). DEPRECATE the vestigial `agent` lifecycle: validator now REJECTS `lifecycle` on type=agent ([dod.6]). validate() enforces profiles ⊆ serves, known host surfaces, refuses managed (claude) / project-forbidden (codex) keys. Additive to the schema otherwise — back-compat for existing manifests. validate()'s signature is unchanged (behavior only), so no `changes` symbol churn.

capability-engine.notes: The 6 capabilities, each apply/reverse/diff/verify, idempotent + (host,scope)-aware. `config-merge` is FORMAT-AWARE (json AND toml) [inv:format-aware-merge]. Every config-merge/array-merge writes a per-scope provenance ledger action [inv:ledger-reversible] (project ledger committed+portable; user ledger ~/.soxe local). Parallel with host-registry (disjoint files). No callers wired yet — keeps downstream guards red→green.

host-registry.notes: Pluggable per-host modules {detect(), scopePaths(scope), surfaces{}}. Ship TWO: claude (verified matrix from spec §4) + codex (TOML, spec §4b). Encodes project-forbidden keys (codex: model_providers/notify/profile/otel) + never-managed (claude) [inv:never-managed]. FIRST resolve P0.6: verify codex skills path (.agents/skills vs ~/.codex/skills) + plugin paths against the installed Codex CLI; record what was verified. Parallel with capability-engine.

audit-foundation.notes: Phase-cumulative audit runner (PATH-augmented _run so bare nx resolves). Checks all [schema-delta.*]/[capability-engine.*]/[host-registry.*]. Likely failures: agent-lifecycle still accepted; config-merge not round-tripping toml; ledger action not reversible; codex path unverified.

Author writes tools via serve(defineTool(...)); wrapper adds transport selection (stdio | sse/http via flag/env set by the install profile), health, shutdown, and C6 policy-env enforcement at the resource sink [inv:c6-holds] — uniform across claude-stdio + sox-service. Ships ONE generic conformance test inherited by every mcp extension. Parallel with install-lifecycle + generators.

install-lifecycle.notes: Wire install/update/diff/uninstall to the capability engine + host registry + ledger; host-detection defaults --host [inv:host-agnostic-type]. Add `soxe diff`/`soxe update` (declarative-aware) + `--host`/`--profile`/`--scope`/`--trust`. Reality: a markdown agent installs into .claude/agents/ (project+user), diff shows drift, update replaces, uninstall removes — verified on disk. SYMBOL: the exported `install()` (libs/install-engine/src/install.ts:358) is re-signed to the descriptor contract — code callers are `cmdInstall` (apps/sox/src/main.ts, mutated) + bin/sox; deliberately NOT in `changes.resigns` because the token `install` is grep-hostile (floods `--discover` with docs-prose false positives) — caller mapping is hand-verified in final-review.md per the skill's 'semantic analysis is the planner's job'. MERGE PROTOCOL: shares bin/sox + apps/sox/main.ts with generators — coordinate (see both contexts). Parallel with mcp-runtime + generators.

generators.notes: nx-style init options per Appendix A: --content @path / --from @dir, --inject (prompt), --profile/--mode (mcp), --surface (command), --host, --transports, --trust. Emits the HYBRID install descriptor + serves/profiles from chosen options. `--content @source` fills the artifact body + stamps `source:` provenance (the ingestion primitive [dod.7]). Born-conformant (byte-identical parity preserved). MERGE PROTOCOL with install-lifecycle on bin/sox + apps/sox/main.ts. Parallel with mcp-runtime.
